posts.text:
Former Defense Secretary Esper on Trump re Iran: “He lost the war.” There will be two measures of success: the Strait of Hormuz and the nuclear program. 

Esper thinks economic pressure is the path forward because of how dire Iran is doing on that front. #AspenSecurity
